ad_library.summary: 2 live Meta ads confirmed on 2026-11-21 by opening each library ID directly. Both ads sell rooftop solar (residential, commercial, industrial, petrol-bunk) with the Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy and a March 2027 deadline, and both click to WhatsApp. The website was read live the same day. Google Ads Transparency records were not checked in this pass.

funnel.meaning: Both live ads click straight to a WhatsApp chat. The enquiry never reaches kakatiyaenergies.com, so the website cannot measure, retarget or attribute this spend.

findings: Both live ads click to WhatsApp, not to the website - the enquiry never reaches kakatiyaenergies.com, so the site cannot measure or retarget this spend.

The March 2027 subsidy deadline is the strongest urgency lever in the copy, but the website's quote page does not restate the deadline or the Rs.78,000 subsidy figure, so a visitor who lands on the site loses the reason to act now.
The homepage slider carries five H1 headings (farms, irrigation, rooftop, commercial, industrial), which dilutes the single message a rooftop buyer needs.
No WhatsApp link was found in the rendered website content, even though both ads sell through WhatsApp - the two channels are not connected on the site.
Testimonials are present and named, and the site states 700+ happy clients, but neither live ad uses that social proof - both ads lead with price and subsidy only.
next_steps: Point at least one ad at a website landing page that restates the Rs.78,000 subsidy and the March 2027 deadline, with a Meta Pixel so the click can be measured and retargeted.
Add the WhatsApp number (+91 81258 01257) to the website header so the channel the ads already use is one tap away for site visitors.
Reduce the homepage to one H1 (rooftop solar for homes) and move farms/irrigation/industrial to their own service pages.
Add a customer-count or testimonial line to the ad copy - the site already has 700+ clients and named reviews to borrow.

site_audit.scope_note: The website was read live on 2026-11-21 through a rendered-content fetch. Tracking-pixel and head checks (Meta Pixel, GA4, GTM, Google Ads, meta description, Open Graph, JSON-LD) need the raw served HTML and were not captured through this channel, so they are recorded as not checked rather than absent. PageSpeed and sitemap were not run.

issues: No contact form on homepage — visitors can't easily enquire
No WhatsApp link — losing mobile leads (WhatsApp converts 3x better for Indian home services)
No live chat — missing after-hours leads

site_evidence.note: Head HTML not captured through the sandbox fetch channel; pixel presence is not checked, not absent.

promise_gap.promise: Up to Rs.78,000 subsidy under PM Surya Ghar (both ads)
promise_gap.site: The quote page and services do not restate the Rs.78,000 figure or the March 2027 deadline.
The site offers a quote request but does not name a free site visit or its booking steps.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
